BRAKE - BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER
7. REMOVE RESERVOIR
(a) Pull out the reservoir stopper.
HINT:
At the time of installation, make sure to insert the reservoir stop­
per through holes of the reservoir and the master cylinder
groove.
(b) Remove the reseivoir and 2 grommets.
(c) Remove the cap and strainer from the reservoir.
